subject: DI02000161

title.gu: 3.1 Boolean Function શા માટે Simplify કરવું?

h.gu: Boolean Function શા માટે Simplify કરવું?

body.en:
Understand the idea

Equivalent logic can use fewer gates,literals and levels while preserving the required truth table.

Explanation and application

  • F=AB+AB′=A(B+B′)=A:the output does not depend on B.A direct wire replaces two AND gates,one OR and an inverter in this expression-level model.
  • Compare literal count,gate count and logic depth under the available gate library;the shortest SOP is not always the lowest-cost physical circuit.
  • Simplification is not permission to change specified rows.Hazards,fan-out and propagation delays need separate checks;minimum Boolean expression alone does not guarantee glitch-free switching.
Why Gray order in a K-map?

Adjacent cells must differ in exactly one variable to eliminate that variable by grouping.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Required truth table જાળવીને equivalent logicમાં gates,literals તથા levels ઘટાડી શકાય.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • F=AB+AB′=A(B+B′)=Aહોવાથી output Bપર depend કરતું નથી.Expression-level modelમાં બે AND,એક OR તથા inverterને બદલે direct wire પૂરતો છે.
  • Available gate library પ્રમાણે literal count,gate count અને logic depth compare કરો.Shortest SOP હંમેશાં lowest-cost physical circuit નથી.
  • Simplificationથી specified rows બદલી શકાતાં નથી.Hazards,fan-out/delay અલગ તપાસવાના છે;minimum expressionથી glitch-free switchingની guarantee નથી.
K-mapમાં Gray Order કેમ?

Groupingથીvariableદૂરકરવામાટેadjacentcellsએકજvariableથીજુદાહોવાજોઈએ.

body.en:
Understand the idea

SOP is an OR of AND terms;POS is an AND of OR terms.Canonical forms contain every variable in each term.

Explanation and application

  • With A as MSB and B as LSB,row01has minterm A′B and maxterm(A+B′).A minterm is1only on its indexed row;a maxterm is0only on its indexed row.
  • For XOR:F=Σm(1,2)=A′B+AB′=ΠM(0,3)=(A+B)(A′+B′).List all remaining rows as zeroes when converting Σm to ΠM.
  • Noncanonical SOP A+BC is valid SOP but not canonical in three variables.Expand a missing variable using X+X′=1,or build a truth table first.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

SOP એ AND termsનું OR અને POS એ OR termsનું AND છે.Canonical formના દરેક termમાં બધા variables આવે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • A=MSB,B=LSBલઈ row01નો minterm A′B તથા maxterm(A+B′)છે.Minterm indexed row પર જ1અને maxterm indexed row પર જ0હોય છે.
  • XOR માટે F=Σm(1,2)=A′B+AB′=ΠM(0,3)=(A+B)(A′+B′)છે.Σmથી ΠMમાં બાકીના બધા rows zero લો.
  • Three variablesમાં A+BC valid SOP છે પણ canonical નથી.Missing variable માટે X+X′=1થી expand કરો અથવા પહેલાં truth table બનાવો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

A K-map rearranges the truth table into Gray order so adjacent cells differ in one variable.

Explanation and application

  • For2variables use row A=0,1 and column B=0,1.For3variables use row A=0,1 and column BC=00,01,11,10;ordinary binary order00,01,10,11is wrong.
  • For SOP group1cells in rectangles of1,2,4,8…cells.Use the largest useful groups,cover every required1and avoid0cells.Overlap is allowed;diagonal grouping is not.
  • Top/bottom and left/right edges wrap.A variable that changes within a group disappears;retain only literals fixed across every cell.
  • For POS group0cells.Fixed0gives an uncomplemented literal in the sum term;fixed1gives a complemented literal.This polarity reverses the SOP rule.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

K-mapમાં truth table Gray orderમાં ગોઠવાય છે,જેથી adjacent cells એક variableમાં જુદા પડે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • 2variablesમાં row A=0,1,column B=0,1લો.3variablesમાં row A=0,1,column BC=00,01,11,10લો;ordinary binary order00,01,10,11ખોટો છે.
  • SOPમાં1cellsના1,2,4,8…sizeના rectangles લો.Largest useful groupsથી દરેક required1cover કરો;0cell ન લો.Overlap allowed છે,diagonal grouping નહિ.
  • Top/bottom તથા left/right edges adjacent છે.Groupમાં બદલાતો variable દૂર થાય છે;બધા cellsમાં fixed literals જ રાખો.
  • POSમાં0cells group કરો.Fixed0એ sum termમાં uncomplemented literal અને fixed1એ complemented literal આપે.આ polarity SOPથી ઊલટી છે.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

F(A,B)=Σm(1,3);G(A,B,C)=Σm(1,3,5,7).

Step-by-step solution

  1. F has1at01and11;pair across A,retain B=1→F=B.
  2. G has the four C=1cells:columns BC01and11across both A rows.The four-cell group removes A,B→G=C.
  3. For F zeros at00and10give one POS group with B=0,so F=(B).Verify all rows,not just one selected case.

Interpretation and check

The map labels are minterm indices,not decimal values to add.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

F(A,B)=Σm(1,3);G(A,B,C)=Σm(1,3,5,7).

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Fમાં01અને11પર1છે.Aની બંને rows pair કરતાં B=1રહે;F=B.
  2. Gમાં C=1ના ચાર cells છે:બંને A rowsમાં BC01/11columns.Four-cell groupથી A,Bદૂર થાય;G=C.
  3. Fના00/10zero cellsનું POS group B=0આપે,તેથી F=(B).એક case નહિ,બધા rows verify કરો.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Mapના labels minterm indices છે;ઉમેરવાના decimal values નથી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Rows AB and columns CD both use00,01,11,10;there are16cells.

Explanation and application

  • F=Σm(1,3,9,11):rows AB00and10wrap;columns CD01and11are adjacent.The four-cell group holds B=0,D=1,so F=B′D.
  • Group size2^k eliminates k varying variables.Only a legal rectangle in the wrapped map counts;four isolated1cells are not automatically a group of4.
  • Choose essential prime implicants first,then cover remaining required1cells economically.Recheck each minterm against the resulting expression.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Rows ABઅને columns CDબંને00,01,11,10ક્રમમાં છે;કુલ16cells છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • F=Σm(1,3,9,11)માં AB00/10rows edge-wrap કરે અને CD01/11columns adjacent છે.Groupમાં B=0,D=1રહે;F=B′D.
  • 2^ksizeનું group kબદલાતા variables દૂર કરે.Wrapped mapમાં legal rectangle જ ગણાય;ચાર અલગ1cells આપમેળે4નું group નથી.
  • પહેલાં essential prime implicants લો,પછી બાકી required1cellsને economical groupsથી cover કરો.Resulting expressionના દરેક mintermને recheck કરો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

F=Σm(1,3,7,11,15)+d(5,9,13),variables A,B,C,D.

Step-by-step solution

  1. The required1cells and optional Xcells together occupy all eight D=1positions.Group them as8→F=D.
  2. Xmay be used as0or1if useful;it need not be covered.Every required0must remain0and every required1must remain1.
  3. An invalid BCD input is not automatically safe to treat as Xif hardware can actually receive it.Specify handling or guarantee it cannot occur.

Interpretation and check

Do not compare implementations on Xrows as if an unspecified output had a required value.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

F=Σm(1,3,7,11,15)+d(5,9,13),variables A,B,C,D.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Required1અને optional Xcells મળીને D=1ના આઠ positions બને છે.8નું group લો;F=D.
  2. Useful હોય ત્યારે Xને0અથવા1લો;Xcover કરવું ફરજિયાત નથી.દરેક required0એ0અને required1એ1જ રહેવું જોઈએ.
  3. Hardwareને invalid BCD input મળી શકે તો તેને આપમેળે Xમાનવું safe નથી.Handling specify કરો અથવા તે ક્યારેય ન આવવાની guarantee આપો.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Xrowsના unspecified outputને required value માની implementations compare ન કરો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

F=ΠM(0,1,2,3,4,8,12),variable order A,B,C,D.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Group the four zeroes0,1,2,3in row AB=00.The fixed zeros A=0,B=0give maxterm(A+B).
  2. Group zeroes0,4,8,12in column CD=00.Fixed C=0,D=0give maxterm(C+D);zero0can be shared.
  3. F=(A+B)(C+D)=AC+AD+BC+BD.The two ORoutputs feed an AND;check all16rows against the original zero index list.

Interpretation and check

For POS,retain fixed0as uncomplemented and fixed1as complemented:the reverse of SOP grouping.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

F=ΠM(0,1,2,3,4,8,12),variable order A,B,C,D.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. AB=00rowના0,1,2,3ચારzeroesgroupકરો.FixedA=0,B=0થીmaxterm(A+B)મળે.
  2. CD=00columnના0,4,8,12zeroesgroupકરો.FixedC=0,D=0થીmaxterm(C+D)મળે;zero0shareકરીશકાય.
  3. F=(A+B)(C+D)=AC+AD+BC+BDછે.બેORoutputsANDમાંઆપો;originalzeroindexlistસામે16rowsતપાસો.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

POSમાંfixed0uncomplemented તથાfixed1complementedરાખો;SOPથીઊલટોruleછે.

body.en:
Aim

Simplify a specified truth table and verify basic-gate realisation.

Instruments and preparation

  • Use the approved low-voltage current-limited trainer,verified logic ICs/breadboard,defined input switches,logic probe or high-impedance meter,and exact device datasheet.A simulated/numerical practical needs its stated tools instead.
  • Check package orientation and recommended VCCbefore connecting.Power OFFfor wiring;do not apply a9Vbattery directly to74LSlogic;trainer0–30Vcapability is not an IC operating rating.

Circuit connections / setup

Use F(A,B,C)=Σm(3,5,7).Group3/7→BCand5/7→AC;build F=AC+BC.

Procedure

  1. Derive the expected table first;declare bit order,active polarity and any enable/clock assumptions.
  2. Inspect the unpowered connections against the labelled logic diagram and approved pin map;verify common ground and a suitable local decoupling capacitor.
  3. Compare all8rows of the original truth table and simplified network;minterm7is legally shared.
  4. Read each output after settling;for sequential circuits record current state,command,clock event and next state separately.
  5. On a mismatch,stop and trace supply,input definition,polarity and intermediate nodes;power OFFbefore changing wiring.
  6. Save genuine results and explain each discrepancy;power down safely.Do not fill actual observations with expected numbers or claim an unperformed experiment.

Expected calculations and interpretation

F=1at3,5,7and0elsewhere;equivalent factored form is C(A+B).

Fault finding

A diagonal pair is illegal;check Gray order before suspecting a damaged IC.

Precautions

  • Never short outputs or exceed ratings;unused inputs must be defined.Output LEDloads need a checked driver/current limiter;an LEDwired to VCCmay indicate logicLOWwhen lit.
  • Use only isolated approved low-voltage apparatus;do not connect mains to logic circuits.A safe trainer is not a guarantee against reversed supply or incorrect pinout.

Actual observations:blank learner evidence

body.gu:
હેતુ

Specified truth tableને simplifyકરી basic-gate realisationverifyકરો.

સાધનો તથા તૈયારી

  • Approvedlow-voltagecurrent-limitedtrainer,verifiedICs/breadboard,definedswitches,logicprobe/high-impedancemeterતથા exactdatasheetલો.Simulation/numericalpracticalમાં એનાં statedtoolsલો.
  • Connectપહેલાં orientation/recommendedVCCજુઓ.Wiringમાં powerOFFરાખો.74LSને સીધી9Vbatteryનઆપો;trainerની0–30VcapabilityICratingનથી.

Circuit Connections / Setup

F(A,B,C)=Σm(3,5,7)લો.3/7→BCઅને5/7→ACgroupsથી F=AC+BCબનાવો.

પ્રક્રિયા

  1. પહેલાં expectedtablederiveકરો.Bitorder,activepolarityતથા enable/clockassumptionsલખો.
  2. Unpoweredconnectionsને logicdiagram/approvedpinmapસાથે તપાસો.Common ground તથા યોગ્ય localdecouplingcapacitorજુઓ.
  3. Original/simplifiedબંનેના8rowscompareકરો;minterm7shareકરવું legalછે.
  4. Settleથયા પછી દરેકoutputવાંચો.Sequentialમાં currentstate,command,clockevent/nextstateઅલગલખો.
  5. Mismatchમાં રોકાઈ supply,inputdefinition,polarity/intermediatenodestraceકરો.Wiringબદલતાંપહેલાં powerOFFકરો.
  6. Genuine resultsસાચવો,discrepancyસમજાવો અને safelypowerdownકરો.Expectednumbersactualobservationsમાં નભરો;નકરેલ experimentનો દાવો નકરો.

Expected ગણતરી તથા અર્થ

Fના3,5,7પર1અનેબીજે0;equivalent factored form C(A+B)છે.

Fault Finding

Diagonal pairillegalછે.ICfaultમાનતાંપહેલાં Grayorderતપાસો.

સાવચેતી

  • Outputs shortકેratings exceedનકરો.Unusedinputsdefinedરાખો.LEDloadમાટે checkeddriver/currentlimiterલો.VCCથીજોડાયેલ LEDજલતાં logicLOWદર્શાવી શકે.
  • Isolatedapprovedlow-voltageapparatusજલો.Logiccircuitને mainsનજોડો.Safe trainerપણ reversed supply/wrongpinoutથીરક્ષણનીguaranteeનથી.

body.en:
Aim

Realise the simplified function with an all-NAND or all-NOR network.

Instruments and preparation

  • Use the approved low-voltage current-limited trainer,verified logic ICs/breadboard,defined input switches,logic probe or high-impedance meter,and exact device datasheet.A simulated/numerical practical needs its stated tools instead.
  • Check package orientation and recommended VCCbefore connecting.Power OFFfor wiring;do not apply a9Vbattery directly to74LSlogic;trainer0–30Vcapability is not an IC operating rating.

Circuit connections / setup

For F=AC+BC,use NAND(A,C),NAND(B,C),then NAND of those outputs.All-NOR uses F=C(A+B),so NOR(C,C),NOR(A,B),then NOR of those nodes.

Procedure

  1. Derive the expected table first;declare bit order,active polarity and any enable/clock assumptions.
  2. Inspect the unpowered connections against the labelled logic diagram and approved pin map;verify common ground and a suitable local decoupling capacitor.
  3. Draw the3-gate network,verify internal polarities and test all8input combinations for both alternatives.
  4. Read each output after settling;for sequential circuits record current state,command,clock event and next state separately.
  5. On a mismatch,stop and trace supply,input definition,polarity and intermediate nodes;power OFFbefore changing wiring.
  6. Save genuine results and explain each discrepancy;power down safely.Do not fill actual observations with expected numbers or claim an unperformed experiment.

Expected calculations and interpretation

Both variants equal C(A+B);the last universal gate removes the internal complemented polarity.

Fault finding

Adding an extra output inverter reverses the intended function.Check the two-level bubble cancellation.

Precautions

  • Never short outputs or exceed ratings;unused inputs must be defined.Output LEDloads need a checked driver/current limiter;an LEDwired to VCCmay indicate logicLOWwhen lit.
  • Use only isolated approved low-voltage apparatus;do not connect mains to logic circuits.A safe trainer is not a guarantee against reversed supply or incorrect pinout.

સાધનો તથા તૈયારી

  • Approvedlow-voltagecurrent-limitedtrainer,verifiedICs/breadboard,definedswitches,logicprobe/high-impedancemeterતથા exactdatasheetલો.Simulation/numericalpracticalમાં એનાં statedtoolsલો.
  • Connectપહેલાં orientation/recommendedVCCજુઓ.Wiringમાં powerOFFરાખો.74LSને સીધી9Vbatteryનઆપો;trainerની0–30VcapabilityICratingનથી.

Circuit Connections / Setup

F=AC+BCમાટે NAND(A,C),NAND(B,C)પછી બંનેનું NANDલો.All-NORમાં F=C(A+B)થી NOR(C,C),NOR(A,B)પછી બંનેનું NORલો.

પ્રક્રિયા

  1. પહેલાં expectedtablederiveકરો.Bitorder,activepolarityતથા enable/clockassumptionsલખો.
  2. Unpoweredconnectionsને logicdiagram/approvedpinmapસાથે તપાસો.Common ground તથા યોગ્ય localdecouplingcapacitorજુઓ.
  3. 3-gatenetworkદોરો,internal polaritiesતપાસો અને બંને alternativesના8inputsલો.
  4. Settleથયા પછી દરેકoutputવાંચો.Sequentialમાં currentstate,command,clockevent/nextstateઅલગલખો.
  5. Mismatchમાં રોકાઈ supply,inputdefinition,polarity/intermediatenodestraceકરો.Wiringબદલતાંપહેલાં powerOFFકરો.
  6. Genuine resultsસાચવો,discrepancyસમજાવો અને safelypowerdownકરો.Expectednumbersactualobservationsમાં નભરો;નકરેલ experimentનો દાવો નકરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Suggested project plan,not completed experiment evidence.

Explanation and application

  • Choose convention00OFF,01ON,10ON,11OFF:changing either switch toggles the light.Model low-voltage indicator only,not actual mains staircase wiring.
  • F=A′B+AB′=A⊕B.AND/OR/inverter realisation uses two complemented literals,two products and an OR.K-map1cells are diagonal and cannot merge.
  • Two-input NAND-only XOR needs4gates:N=NAND(A,B);P=NAND(A,N);Q=NAND(B,N);F=NAND(P,Q).Two-input NOR-only XOR needs5gates:N=NOR(A,B);P=NOR(A,N);Q=NOR(B,N);X=NOR(P,Q)gives XNOR;F=NOR(X,X).
  • These minimum counts assume only two-input gates,no complemented inputs supplied,and the chosen XORpolarity;choosing the opposite light convention changes the function/counts.
  • Deliver problem analysis,logic expression/simplification,block and logic diagrams,full expected truth/state table,components,pin references and blank genuine-result section;report only work actually performed.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Suggested project planછે;completed experiment evidenceનહિ.

Aim

Simplify a specified truth table and verify basic-gate realisation.

Instruments and preparation

  • Use the approved low-voltage current-limited trainer,verified logic ICs/breadboard,defined input switches,logic probe or high-impedance meter,and exact device datasheet.A simulated/numerical practical needs its stated tools instead.
  • Check package orientation and recommended VCCbefore connecting.Power OFFfor wiring;do not apply a9Vbattery directly to74LSlogic;trainer0–30Vcapability is not an IC operating rating.

Circuit connections / setup

Use F(A,B,C)=Σm(3,5,7).Group3/7→BCand5/7→AC;build F=AC+BC.

Procedure

  1. Derive the expected table first;declare bit order,active polarity and any enable/clock assumptions.
  2. Inspect the unpowered connections against the labelled logic diagram and approved pin map;verify common ground and a suitable local decoupling capacitor.
  3. Compare all8rows of the original truth table and simplified network;minterm7is legally shared.
  4. Read each output after settling;for sequential circuits record current state,command,clock event and next state separately.
  5. On a mismatch,stop and trace supply,input definition,polarity and intermediate nodes;power OFFbefore changing wiring.
  6. Save genuine results and explain each discrepancy;power down safely.Do not fill actual observations with expected numbers or claim an unperformed experiment.

Expected calculations and interpretation

F=1at3,5,7and0elsewhere;equivalent factored form is C(A+B).

Fault finding

A diagonal pair is illegal;check Gray order before suspecting a damaged IC.

Precautions

  • Never short outputs or exceed ratings;unused inputs must be defined.Output LEDloads need a checked driver/current limiter;an LEDwired to VCCmay indicate logicLOWwhen lit.
  • Use only isolated approved low-voltage apparatus;do not connect mains to logic circuits.A safe trainer is not a guarantee against reversed supply or incorrect pinout.

body.en: Choose convention00OFF,01ON,10ON,11OFF:changing either switch toggles the light.Model low-voltage indicator only,not actual mains staircase wiring. F=A′B+AB′=A⊕B.AND/OR/inverter realisation uses two complemented literals,two products and an OR.K-map1cells are diagonal and cannot merge. Two-input NAND-only XOR needs4gates:N=NAND(A,B);P=NAND(A,N);Q=NAND(B,N);F=NAND(P,Q).Two-input NOR-only XOR needs5gates:N=NOR(A,B);P=NOR(A,N);Q=NOR(B,N);X=NOR(P,Q)gives XNOR;F=NOR(X,X). These minimum counts assume only two-input gates,no complemented inputs supplied,and the chosen XORpolarity;choosing the opposite light convention changes the function/counts.
